# tidypptsdm

tidypptsdm watches the feeding stations of a pig performance test from day
to day. It answers the questions of the daily round: is every station
recording, are the transponders read, does every pig still eat, and how
did feed intake and body weight develop over the last days?

The data are read and prepared with
[tidypptsda](https://tony2015116.github.io/tidypptsda/):
`read_station()` reads NEDAP or FIRE exports and `prep_visits()` turns
them into one standard visit table (feed intake in g, body weight in kg,
duration in seconds, unidentified visits kept with `identified = FALSE`,
pigs moved to another station resolved). Both functions are re-exported,
so `library(tidypptsdm)` is enough.

```{r}
library(tidypptsdm)

mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 7, verbose = 0)
mon
```

# Internal helpers

Small internal tools shared by every function of the package:

- **verbosity**: exported functions have `verbose = 0/1/2` (silent /
  summary / details), as in tidypptsda;
- **input**: `as_visits()` accepts a folder or files, a raw export, the
  result of `read_station()` or of `prep_visits()`, and always returns a
  copy, so user objects are never modified;
- **window**: `monitor_window()` turns `days` and `end_date` into the
  dates of the monitoring window.

```{r function-utils}
#' @filename utils
#' @import data.table
#' @importFrom cli cli_abort
#' @keywords internal
"_PACKAGE"

utils::globalVariables(c(
  ".", ".N", ".SD", "date", "duration", "entry_time", "feed_intake",
  "feed_identified_kg", "feed_kg", "feed_per_pig_kg", "first_date", "hour",
  "house", "i.pct_weight_outlier", "i.weight_kg", "identified",
  "last_weight_kg", "level", "location", "low_feed_days",
  "mean_feed", "metric", "n_pigs", "n_stations", "n_unidentified",
  "n_visits", "occupation_h", "occupation_min", "outlier",
  "pct_unidentified", "pct_weight_outlier", "pig", "pig_w", "responder",
  "start", "status", "value", "weight", "weight_kg", "days_since_visit",
  "last_feed_kg", "N", "type", "saved", "file", "plot",
  "i.n_stations", "total", "share", "lo", "hi", "panel"
))

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

# ---- verbosity --------------------------------------------------------------

pptm_verbose <- function() {
  getOption("tidypptsdm.verbose", 1L)
}

check_verbose <- function(verbose) {
  if (!is.numeric(verbose) || length(verbose) != 1L || is.na(verbose) ||
      !verbose %in% 0:2) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg verbose} must be 0 (silent), 1 (summary) or 2 (details).")
  }
  as.integer(verbose)
}

# Set the verbosity until the calling function exits.
local_verbose <- function(verbose, envir = parent.frame()) {
  verbose <- check_verbose(verbose)
  old <- options(tidypptsdm.verbose = verbose, datatable.showProgress = FALSE)
  do.call(on.exit, list(bquote(options(.(old))), add = TRUE), envir = envir)
  invisible(verbose)
}

# Print a message if the current verbosity is at least `level`.
pptm_msg <- function(msg, type = c("info", "success", "warning", "danger", "h1"),
                     level = 1L, .envir = parent.frame()) {
  if (pptm_verbose() < level) return(invisible(NULL))
  type <- match.arg(type)
  switch(type,
    info    = cli::cli_alert_info(msg, .envir = .envir),
    success = cli::cli_alert_success(msg, .envir = .envir),
    warning = cli::cli_alert_warning(msg, .envir = .envir),
    danger  = cli::cli_alert_danger(msg, .envir = .envir),
    h1      = cli::cli_h1(msg, .envir = .envir)
  )
  invisible(NULL)
}

# ---- argument checks --------------------------------------------------------

check_whole <- function(x, arg, min = 1) {
  if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x) || x < min || x != round(x)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg {arg}} must be a whole number of at least {min}, not {.val {format(x)}}.")
  }
  as.integer(x)
}

check_number <- function(x, arg, min = 0) {
  if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x) || x < min) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg {arg}} must be a number of at least {min}, not {.val {format(x)}}.")
  }
  as.numeric(x)
}

check_monitor <- function(x) {
  if (!inherits(x, "pptm_monitor")) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg x} must be the result of {.fn run_monitor}.")
  }
  invisible(x)
}

check_path <- function(path) {
  if (!is.character(path) || length(path) != 1L || is.na(path) || !nzchar(path)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg path} must be a folder name.")
  }
  path
}

# ---- input ------------------------------------------------------------------

visit_cols <- c("responder", "identified", "location", "date", "entry_time",
                "duration", "feed_intake", "weight")

# TRUE for the result of prep_visits().
is_visits <- function(data) {
  is.data.frame(data) && all(visit_cols %in% names(data))
}

# Standard visit table from any input; always a copy.
as_visits <- function(data, station = NULL, verbose = 1) {
  if (is.character(data)) {
    data <- tidypptsda::read_station(data, station = station, verbose = verbose)
  }
  if (!is.data.frame(data)) {
    cli::cli_abort(c(
      "{.arg data} must be station data.",
      "i" = "Give a folder or files of station exports, a raw export already in R (e.g. {.code tidypptsda::nedap}), or the result of {.fn read_station} or {.fn prep_visits}."
    ))
  }
  if (is_visits(data)) {
    v <- data.table::copy(data.table::as.data.table(data))
    if (is.null(attr(v, "station"))) data.table::setattr(v, "station", attr(data, "station"))
  } else {
    v <- tidypptsda::prep_visits(data, station = station, verbose = verbose)
  }
  if (!inherits(v$date, "Date")) v[, date := as.Date(date)]
  v[, location := as.character(location)]
  v[, responder := as.character(responder)]
  v
}

# ---- monitoring window --------------------------------------------------------

# Last day of the window: the last day in the data, but the day before when
# that is today (an export taken during the day has an incomplete last day).
resolve_end_date <- function(end_date, visits) {
  if (is.null(end_date)) {
    if (nrow(visits) == 0L || all(is.na(visits$date))) {
      cli::cli_abort("{.arg data} has no visits with a date.")
    }
    last <- max(visits$date, na.rm = TRUE)
    today <- Sys.Date()
    if (last >= today) last <- today - 1L
    return(last)
  }
  d <- tryCatch(as.Date(end_date), error = function(e) as.Date(NA))
  if (length(d) != 1L || is.na(d)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg end_date} must be a date such as {.val 2024-05-25}, not {.val {format(end_date)}}.")
  }
  d
}

monitor_window <- function(visits, days, end_date) {
  days <- check_whole(days, "days")
  end <- resolve_end_date(end_date, visits)
  start <- end - (days - 1L)
  list(start = start, end = end, days = days,
       dates = seq(start, end, by = "day"))
}

window_visits <- function(visits, win) {
  visits[!is.na(location) & !is.na(date) & date >= win$start & date <= win$end]
}

# Stations monitored: those with a visit in the window or in the 14 days
# before it. A station that stopped recording shows up (and alerts) for two
# weeks; one taken out of the test earlier is no longer listed.
active_days <- 14L

active_locations <- function(visits, start, end) {
  natural_order(visits[!is.na(location) & !is.na(date) &
                         date >= start - active_days & date <= end, location])
}

# ---- small tools ----------------------------------------------------------------

# Stations and pigs in natural order: "2" before "10".
natural_order <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(as.character(x[!is.na(x)]))
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", x)))
  x[order(is.na(num), num, x)]
}

order_natural <- function(dt, cols) {
  keys <- lapply(cols, function(col) match(dt[[col]], natural_order(dt[[col]])))
  dt[do.call(order, keys)]
}

# Tukey fences within a group; fewer than 4 weights are never outliers.
iqr_outlier <- function(x, k) {
  if (length(x) < 4L) return(rep(FALSE, length(x)))
  q <- stats::quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75), names = FALSE)
  r <- q[2L] - q[1L]
  x < q[1L] - k * r | x > q[2L] + k * r
}

# Round the result columns by their unit.
round_cols <- function(dt) {
  for (col in names(dt)) {
    if (!is.double(dt[[col]])) next
    d <- if (col == "weight_kg" || col == "last_weight_kg") 2L
         else if (endsWith(col, "_kg")) 3L
         else if (startsWith(col, "pct_")) 1L
         else if (endsWith(col, "_h")) 2L
         else if (endsWith(col, "_min")) 1L
         else NA_integer_
    if (!is.na(d)) data.table::set(dt, j = col, value = round(dt[[col]], d))
  }
  dt
}

nan_to_na <- function(x) {
  x[is.nan(x)] <- NA_real_
  x
}

# Okabe-Ito palette: colour-blind safe, no extra dependency.
pptm_palette <- function(n) {
  pal <- c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7", "#E69F00",
           "#56B4E9", "#F0E442", "#000000", "#999999")
  if (n > length(pal)) pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(pal)(n)
  pal[seq_len(n)]
}
```

```{r tests-utils}
test_that("natural order and outliers", {
  expect_equal(natural_order(c("10", "2", "1", NA)), c("1", "2", "10"))
  expect_equal(iqr_outlier(c(1, 2, 3), 1.5), rep(FALSE, 3))
  expect_equal(iqr_outlier(c(50, 51, 52, 51, 50, 90), 1.5), c(rep(FALSE, 5), TRUE))
})

test_that("window ends on the last full day", {
  v <- data.table::data.table(date = as.Date(c("2024-05-01", "2024-05-10")))
  w <- monitor_window(v, 3, NULL)
  expect_equal(w$end, as.Date("2024-05-10"))
  expect_equal(w$dates, as.Date("2024-05-08") + 0:2)
  today <- data.table::data.table(date = Sys.Date())
  expect_equal(monitor_window(today, 1, NULL)$end, Sys.Date() - 1L)
  expect_equal(monitor_window(v, 1, "2024-05-05")$end, as.Date("2024-05-05"))
  expect_error(monitor_window(v, 0, NULL), "days")
  expect_error(monitor_window(v, 2, "not a date"), "end_date")
})

test_that("input is never modified", {
  raw <- data.table::as.data.table(tidypptsda::nedap)
  before <- data.table::copy(raw)
  v <- as_visits(raw, verbose = 0)
  expect_identical(raw, before)
  v2 <- as_visits(v, verbose = 0)
  v2[, feed_intake := 0]
  expect_false(all(v$feed_intake == 0))
  expect_error(as_visits(1:3), "station data")
})
```

# Re-exported from tidypptsda

```{r function-reexports}
#' Read and Prepare Station Data (from tidypptsda)
#'
#' These functions come from
#' [tidypptsda](https://tony2015116.github.io/tidypptsda/) and are
#' re-exported so that `library(tidypptsdm)` is enough:
#' - [read_station()][tidypptsda::read_station]: read NEDAP or FIRE exports
#'   (CSV, TXT, Excel; many files or a folder);
#' - [prep_visits()][tidypptsda::prep_visits]: turn them into the standard
#'   visit table used by every function of tidypptsdm.
#'
#' Every monitor function also accepts the folder, the raw export or the
#' result of `read_station()` directly and calls `prep_visits()` itself.
#'
#' @filename reexports
#' @name reexports
#' @aliases read_station prep_visits
#' @importFrom tidypptsda read_station prep_visits
#' @export read_station prep_visits
#' @keywords internal
NULL
```

# One monitoring run

`run_monitor()` is the function for the daily round. It prepares the
visits once, computes every table over the last `days` days and lists
the alerts of the last day. Its result goes to `write_monitor_report()`,
`write_monitor_tables()` and `plot_monitor()`.

The window ends on `end_date`. By default this is the last day in the
data; when that is today, it is the day before, because an export taken
during the day has an incomplete last day.

```{r function-run_monitor}
#' Monitor the Stations over the Last Days
#'
#' @description
#' Prepare the visits once, compute the daily tables of the monitoring
#' window (stations, houses, pigs, hours of the last day) and list the
#' alerts of the last day.
#'
#' @param data Station data: a folder or files of NEDAP or FIRE exports
#'   (read with [read_station()]), a raw export already in R such as
#'   [tidypptsda::nedap], or the result of [read_station()] or
#'   [prep_visits()].
#' @param days Number of days in the window, ending on `end_date`.
#'   Default 7.
#' @param end_date Last day of the window (a `Date` or `"YYYY-MM-DD"`).
#'   Default `NULL`: the last day in the data, or yesterday when the last
#'   day is today (an export taken during the day is incomplete).
#' @param house_width Number of leading characters of the station ID that
#'   name its house, e.g. `1` for station `"203"` in house `"2"`.
#'   Default 1.
#' @param low_feed_kg A pig that ate less than this on a day (kg) is
#'   `"low_feed"`. Default 0.5.
#' @param max_unidentified_pct Alert when more than this percentage of the
#'   visits of a station are unidentified on the last day. Default 5.
#' @param max_feed_drop_pct Alert when the feed intake of a station on the
#'   last day is more than this percentage below its mean of the earlier
#'   days of the window. Default 30.
#' @param iqr_k Body weights of a pig on a day outside the Tukey fences
#'   (quartiles -/+ `iqr_k` times the interquartile range) are outliers.
#'   Default 1.5.
#' @param station `"nedap"`, `"fire"` or `NULL` (detect), passed to
#'   [read_station()] and [prep_visits()].
#' @param verbose 0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).
#'
#' @return An object of class `pptm_monitor`, a list with:
#'   - `stations`: [monitor_stations()], one row per station and day;
#'   - `houses`: [monitor_houses()], one row per house and day;
#'   - `pigs`: [monitor_pigs()], one row per pig and day;
#'   - `pig_summary`: one row per pig over the window (see below);
#'   - `hours`: [monitor_hours()] of the last day;
#'   - `alerts`: the alerts of the last day (see below);
#'   - `visits`: the visits of the window;
#'   - `settings`: the arguments, the window and the station type.
#'
#'   `pig_summary` has `location`, `responder`, `days` (days in the
#'   window since the pig was first seen), `no_visit_days`,
#'   `low_feed_days`, `mean_feed_kg` (mean daily feed intake, days without
#'   visit count as 0), `last_feed_kg` and `last_visits` (last day),
#'   `last_weight_kg` (last daily median weight), `days_since_visit` and
#'   `status` on the last day.
#'
#' @section Alerts:
#' One row per problem on the last day, with `level` (`"danger"` or
#' `"warning"`), `type`, `location`, `responder` (pig alerts), `value` and
#' `message`:
#'
#' | type | level | when |
#' |---|---|---|
#' | `station_down` | danger | no visit at all on the station |
#' | `unidentified` | warning | more than `max_unidentified_pct` % of the visits unidentified (transponder or antenna) |
#' | `feed_drop` | warning | feed intake more than `max_feed_drop_pct` % below the station mean of the earlier days |
#' | `pig_no_visit` | danger | a pig seen in the window did not visit its station |
#' | `pig_low_feed` | warning | a pig ate less than `low_feed_kg` |
#'
#' Pigs of a station without any visit get no pig alert: the
#' `station_down` alert covers them.
#'
#' @seealso [write_monitor_report()], [write_monitor_tables()],
#'   [plot_monitor()], [schedule_monitor()].
#' @export
#' @examples
#' mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 7)
#' mon$alerts
#' head(mon$stations)
#'
#' # Another window and stricter limits
#' mon2 <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::fire, days = 14, end_date = "2024-02-10",
#'                     low_feed_kg = 1, verbose = 0)
#' mon2$pig_summary
run_monitor <- function(data, days = 7, end_date = NULL, house_width = 1,
                        low_feed_kg = 0.5, max_unidentified_pct = 5,
                        max_feed_drop_pct = 30, iqr_k = 1.5, station = NULL,
                        verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  house_width <- check_whole(house_width, "house_width")
  low_feed_kg <- check_number(low_feed_kg, "low_feed_kg")
  max_unidentified_pct <- check_number(max_unidentified_pct, "max_unidentified_pct")
  max_feed_drop_pct <- check_number(max_feed_drop_pct, "max_feed_drop_pct")
  iqr_k <- check_number(iqr_k, "iqr_k")

  v <- as_visits(data, station, verbose)
  win <- monitor_window(v, days, end_date)
  st_type <- attr(v, "station") %||% ""
  pptm_msg("Monitoring {toupper(st_type)} stations: {format(win$start)} to {format(win$end)} ({win$days} day{?s})", "h1")

  w <- window_visits(v, win)
  if (nrow(w) == 0L) {
    pptm_msg("No visits between {format(win$start)} and {format(win$end)}.", "warning")
  }
  stations <- station_table(v, win, iqr_k)
  houses <- house_table(v, win, house_width)
  pigs <- pig_table(v, win, low_feed_kg)
  pig_sum <- pig_summary(pigs, win$end)
  hours <- hour_table(v, win$end)
  alerts <- find_alerts(stations, pig_sum, win$end, low_feed_kg,
                        max_unidentified_pct, max_feed_drop_pct)

  out <- structure(list(
    stations = stations, houses = houses, pigs = pigs, pig_summary = pig_sum,
    hours = hours, alerts = alerts, visits = w,
    settings = list(station = st_type, days = win$days, start_date = win$start,
                    end_date = win$end, house_width = house_width,
                    low_feed_kg = low_feed_kg,
                    max_unidentified_pct = max_unidentified_pct,
                    max_feed_drop_pct = max_feed_drop_pct, iqr_k = iqr_k,
                    created = Sys.time())
  ), class = "pptm_monitor")

  if (pptm_verbose() >= 1L) print_summary(out)
  invisible(out)
}

#' @export
print.pptm_monitor <- function(x, ...) {
  s <- x$settings
  cli::cli_h1("{toupper(s$station)} monitor: {format(s$start_date)} to {format(s$end_date)}")
  print_summary(x)
  cli::cli_text(cli::col_grey(
    "Tables: $stations, $houses, $pigs, $pig_summary, $hours, $alerts. Write them with write_monitor_report() or write_monitor_tables()."
  ))
  invisible(x)
}

print_summary <- function(x) {
  s <- x$settings
  last <- x$stations[date == s$end_date]
  n_st <- nrow(last)
  n_pigs <- nrow(x$pig_summary)
  vis <- sum(last$n_visits)
  feed <- sum(last$feed_kg)
  vis_txt <- paste0(format(vis, big.mark = ","), " visit", if (vis == 1) "" else "s")
  feed_txt <- format(round(feed, 1), nsmall = 1)
  cli::cli_alert_info(
    "{n_st} station{?s}, {n_pigs} pig{?s}; on {format(s$end_date)}: {vis_txt}, {feed_txt} kg feed"
  )
  a <- x$alerts
  if (nrow(a) == 0L) {
    cli::cli_alert_success("No alerts")
  } else {
    n_d <- sum(a$level == "danger")
    n_w <- sum(a$level == "warning")
    cli::cli_alert_warning("{nrow(a)} alert{?s}: {n_d} danger, {n_w} warning")
    show <- utils::head(a, 10L)
    lab <- ifelse(is.na(show$responder), paste("Station", show$location),
                  paste0("Pig ", show$responder, " (station ", show$location, ")"))
    bullets <- stats::setNames(paste0(lab, ": ", show$message),
                               ifelse(show$level == "danger", "x", "!"))
    cli::cli_bullets(gsub("([{}])", "\\1\\1", bullets))
    if (nrow(a) > 10L) cli::cli_text(cli::col_grey("... and {nrow(a) - 10L} more in $alerts"))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r examples-run_monitor}
mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 7)
mon$alerts
head(mon$stations)
```

```{r tests-run_monitor}
test_that("run_monitor returns every table for both station types", {
  for (raw in list(tidypptsda::nedap, tidypptsda::fire)) {
    mon <- run_monitor(raw, days = 5, verbose = 0)
    expect_s3_class(mon, "pptm_monitor")
    expect_named(mon, c("stations", "houses", "pigs", "pig_summary", "hours",
                        "alerts", "visits", "settings"))
    expect_equal(mon$settings$days, 5L)
    expect_equal(data.table::uniqueN(mon$stations$date), 5L)
    expect_true(all(mon$visits$date >= mon$settings$start_date))
    expect_equal(nrow(mon$hours), 24L * data.table::uniqueN(mon$stations$location))
  }
  expect_error(run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, house_width = 0, verbose = 0), "house_width")
  expect_error(run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, low_feed_kg = -1, verbose = 0), "low_feed_kg")
  expect_message(print(run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)), "monitor")
})

test_that("a station without visits and a pig that stops eating are alerts", {
  v <- prep_visits(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
  end <- max(v$date)
  pig <- v[location == "101" & identified, responder[1]]
  spoiled <- v[!(location == "102" & date == end) & !(responder %in% pig & date == end)]
  mon <- run_monitor(spoiled, days = 7, end_date = end, verbose = 0)
  a <- mon$alerts
  expect_true(any(a$type == "station_down" & a$location == "102"))
  expect_true(any(a$type == "pig_no_visit" & a$responder == pig))
  # no pig alerts for a station that is down
  expect_false(any(a$location == "102" & !is.na(a$responder)))
  expect_equal(a$level[1], "danger")
  st <- mon$stations[location == "102" & date == end]
  expect_equal(st$n_visits, 0L)
  expect_true(is.na(st$weight_kg))
})
```

# Daily tables

Each table has one row per unit and day of the window, also for days
without any visit (counts are then 0). That is what makes a station that
stopped recording, or a pig that stopped eating, visible.

## Stations

```{r function-monitor_stations}
#' Daily Table per Station
#'
#' @description
#' One row per station and day of the window: pigs, visits, unidentified
#' visits, occupation time, feed intake and body weight.
#'
#' @inheritParams run_monitor
#'
#' @return A `data.table` with one row per station (`location`) and
#'   `date`, also for days without visits:
#'   - `n_pigs`: pigs with at least one identified visit;
#'   - `n_visits`: all visits; `n_unidentified`: visits without a
#'     transponder read; `pct_unidentified`: their percentage;
#'   - `occupation_h`: total time the station was occupied, hours;
#'   - `feed_kg`: feed intake of all visits, kg; `feed_per_pig_kg`: feed
#'     intake of the identified visits divided by `n_pigs`;
#'   - `weight_kg`: mean over the pigs of their daily median body weight,
#'     outliers excluded;
#'   - `pct_weight_outlier`: percentage of the recorded body weights that
#'     are outliers within the pig and day (see `iqr_k`).
#'
#'   Counts are 0 and the other columns `NA` on days without visits.
#' @seealso [run_monitor()] for all tables at once.
#' @export
#' @examples
#' st <- monitor_stations(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 7, verbose = 0)
#' st
#' # Stations in rows, days in columns
#' wide_table(st, "feed_kg")
monitor_stations <- function(data, days = 7, end_date = NULL, iqr_k = 1.5,
                             station = NULL, verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  iqr_k <- check_number(iqr_k, "iqr_k")
  v <- as_visits(data, station, verbose)
  station_table(v, monitor_window(v, days, end_date), iqr_k)
}

station_table <- function(v, win, iqr_k) {
  locs <- active_locations(v, win$start, win$end)
  w <- window_visits(v, win)
  agg <- w[, .(n_pigs = data.table::uniqueN(responder[identified]),
               n_visits = .N,
               n_unidentified = sum(!identified),
               occupation_h = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE) / 3600,
               feed_kg = sum(feed_intake, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
               feed_identified_kg = sum(feed_intake[identified], na.rm = TRUE) / 1000),
           by = .(location, date)]
  grid <- data.table::CJ(location = locs, date = win$dates)
  res <- agg[grid, on = c("location", "date")]
  res[is.na(n_visits), `:=`(n_pigs = 0L, n_visits = 0L, n_unidentified = 0L,
                            occupation_h = 0, feed_kg = 0, feed_identified_kg = 0)]
  res[, pct_unidentified := data.table::fifelse(n_visits > 0L, 100 * n_unidentified / n_visits, NA_real_)]
  res[, feed_per_pig_kg := data.table::fifelse(n_pigs > 0L, feed_identified_kg / n_pigs, NA_real_)]

  wv <- w[identified == TRUE & !is.na(weight)]
  wv[, outlier := iqr_outlier(weight, iqr_k), by = .(location, date, responder)]
  out_pct <- wv[, .(pct_weight_outlier = 100 * mean(outlier)), by = .(location, date)]
  wt <- wv[outlier == FALSE, .(pig_w = stats::median(weight)), by = .(location, date, responder)
           ][, .(weight_kg = mean(pig_w)), by = .(location, date)]
  res[, `:=`(weight_kg = NA_real_, pct_weight_outlier = NA_real_)]
  res[wt, weight_kg := i.weight_kg, on = c("location", "date")]
  res[out_pct, pct_weight_outlier := i.pct_weight_outlier, on = c("location", "date")]
  res[, feed_identified_kg := NULL]
  data.table::setcolorder(res, c("location", "date", "n_pigs", "n_visits",
                                 "n_unidentified", "pct_unidentified",
                                 "occupation_h", "feed_kg", "feed_per_pig_kg",
                                 "weight_kg", "pct_weight_outlier"))
  res <- order_natural(res, "location")
  res <- round_cols(res)
  data.table::setattr(res, "pptm_table", "stations")
  res[]
}
```

```{r examples-monitor_stations}
st <- monitor_stations(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 7, verbose = 0)
st
wide_table(st, "feed_kg")
```

```{r tests-monitor_stations}
test_that("station table counts visits, pigs and feed", {
  v <- prep_visits(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
  end <- max(v$date)
  st <- monitor_stations(v, days = 3, end_date = end, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(nrow(st), 2L * 3L)
  one <- v[location == "101" & date == end]
  r <- st[location == "101" & date == end]
  expect_equal(r$n_visits, nrow(one))
  expect_equal(r$n_unidentified, sum(!one$identified))
  expect_equal(r$n_pigs, data.table::uniqueN(one[identified == TRUE]$responder))
  expect_equal(r$feed_kg, round(sum(one$feed_intake) / 1000, 3))
  expect_equal(r$occupation_h, round(sum(one$duration) / 3600, 2))
  expect_true(r$weight_kg > 20 && r$weight_kg < 200)
  # a day after the data: zero visits, no weight
  st2 <- monitor_stations(v, days = 2, end_date = end + 1, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(st2[date == end + 1, n_visits], c(0L, 0L))
  expect_true(all(is.na(st2[date == end + 1, pct_unidentified])))
})
```

## Houses

A house is a group of stations, named by the first `house_width`
characters of the station ID.

```{r function-monitor_houses}
#' Daily Table per House
#'
#' @description
#' One row per house and day: the stations of a house are grouped by the
#' first `house_width` characters of their ID.
#'
#' @inheritParams run_monitor
#'
#' @return A `data.table` with one row per `house` and `date`:
#'   `n_stations` (stations of the house in the data), `n_pigs`,
#'   `n_visits`, `feed_kg`, `feed_per_pig_kg` (as in
#'   [monitor_stations()]) and `weight_kg` (mean over the pigs of their
#'   daily median body weight).
#' @seealso [run_monitor()].
#' @export
#' @examples
#' monitor_houses(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 5, verbose = 0)
#' # Every station its own house
#' monitor_houses(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 5, house_width = 3, verbose = 0)
monitor_houses <- function(data, days = 7, end_date = NULL, house_width = 1,
                           station = NULL, verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  house_width <- check_whole(house_width, "house_width")
  v <- as_visits(data, station, verbose)
  house_table(v, monitor_window(v, days, end_date), house_width)
}

house_table <- function(v, win, house_width) {
  locs <- active_locations(v, win$start, win$end)
  st <- data.table::data.table(location = locs)[, house := substr(location, 1L, house_width)]
  n_st <- st[, .(n_stations = .N), by = house]
  w <- window_visits(v, win)[location %in% locs]
  w[, house := substr(location, 1L, house_width)]
  agg <- w[, .(n_pigs = data.table::uniqueN(responder[identified]),
               n_visits = .N,
               feed_kg = sum(feed_intake, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
               feed_identified_kg = sum(feed_intake[identified], na.rm = TRUE) / 1000),
           by = .(house, date)]
  wt <- w[identified == TRUE & !is.na(weight), .(pig_w = stats::median(weight)),
          by = .(house, date, responder)][, .(weight_kg = mean(pig_w)), by = .(house, date)]
  grid <- data.table::CJ(house = natural_order(st$house), date = win$dates)
  res <- agg[grid, on = c("house", "date")]
  res[is.na(n_visits), `:=`(n_pigs = 0L, n_visits = 0L, feed_kg = 0, feed_identified_kg = 0)]
  res[, feed_per_pig_kg := data.table::fifelse(n_pigs > 0L, feed_identified_kg / n_pigs, NA_real_)]
  res[, weight_kg := NA_real_]
  res[wt, weight_kg := i.weight_kg, on = c("house", "date")]
  res[n_st, n_stations := i.n_stations, on = "house"]
  res[, feed_identified_kg := NULL]
  data.table::setcolorder(res, c("house", "date", "n_stations", "n_pigs",
                                 "n_visits", "feed_kg", "feed_per_pig_kg", "weight_kg"))
  res <- order_natural(res, "house")
  res <- round_cols(res)
  data.table::setattr(res, "pptm_table", "houses")
  res[]
}
```

```{r examples-monitor_houses}
monitor_houses(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 5, verbose = 0)
```

```{r tests-monitor_houses}
test_that("houses group stations by the leading characters", {
  v <- prep_visits(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
  h1 <- monitor_houses(v, days = 4, house_width = 1, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(unique(h1$house), "1")
  expect_equal(unique(h1$n_stations), 2L)
  h3 <- monitor_houses(v, days = 4, house_width = 3, verbose = 0)
  st <- monitor_stations(v, days = 4, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(sort(unique(h3$house)), c("101", "102"))
  expect_equal(sum(h1$feed_kg), sum(st$feed_kg), tolerance = 1e-3)
  expect_equal(sum(h3$n_visits), sum(st$n_visits))
})
```

## Pigs

```{r function-monitor_pigs}
#' Daily Table per Pig
#'
#' @description
#' One row per pig and day, from the first day the pig was seen (or the
#' start of the window) to the last day of the window. A day without any
#' visit is kept with `status = "no_visit"`, so a pig that stopped eating
#' is never missing from the table.
#'
#' @inheritParams run_monitor
#'
#' @return A `data.table` with one row per pig (`responder`) and `date`,
#'   for the pigs with at least one identified visit in the window:
#'   - `location`: the station where the pig had most visits in the
#'     window;
#'   - `n_visits`, `feed_kg`, `occupation_min` (minutes), `weight_kg`
#'     (median body weight of the day);
#'   - `status`: `"no_visit"`, `"low_feed"` (less than `low_feed_kg`) or
#'     `"ok"`.
#' @seealso [run_monitor()], whose `pig_summary` sums this table up per
#'   pig.
#' @export
#' @examples
#' pigs <- monitor_pigs(tidypptsda::fire, days = 7, verbose = 0)
#' pigs[status != "ok"]
#' wide_table(pigs, "feed_kg")
monitor_pigs <- function(data, days = 7, end_date = NULL, low_feed_kg = 0.5,
                         station = NULL, verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  low_feed_kg <- check_number(low_feed_kg, "low_feed_kg")
  v <- as_visits(data, station, verbose)
  pig_table(v, monitor_window(v, days, end_date), low_feed_kg)
}

empty_pigs <- function() {
  data.table::data.table(location = character(), responder = character(),
                         date = as.Date(character()), n_visits = integer(),
                         feed_kg = numeric(), occupation_min = numeric(),
                         weight_kg = numeric(), status = character())
}

pig_table <- function(v, win, low_feed_kg) {
  w <- window_visits(v, win)[identified == TRUE]
  if (nrow(w) == 0L) {
    res <- empty_pigs()
    data.table::setattr(res, "pptm_table", "pigs")
    return(res)
  }
  main <- w[, .N, by = .(responder, location)][order(-N)][, .SD[1L], by = responder
           ][, .(responder, location)]
  first <- v[identified == TRUE & !is.na(date), .(first_date = min(date)), by = responder]
  pigs <- first[main, on = "responder"][, start := pmax(first_date, win$start)]
  end <- win$end
  grid <- pigs[, .(date = seq(start, end, by = "day")), by = .(responder, location)]
  pd <- w[, .(n_visits = .N,
              feed_kg = sum(feed_intake, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
              occupation_min = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
              weight_kg = if (all(is.na(weight))) NA_real_ else stats::median(weight, na.rm = TRUE)),
          by = .(responder, date)]
  res <- pd[grid, on = c("responder", "date")]
  res[is.na(n_visits), `:=`(n_visits = 0L, feed_kg = 0, occupation_min = 0)]
  res[, status := data.table::fifelse(n_visits == 0L, "no_visit",
                                      data.table::fifelse(feed_kg < low_feed_kg, "low_feed", "ok"))]
  data.table::setcolorder(res, c("location", "responder", "date", "n_visits",
                                 "feed_kg", "occupation_min", "weight_kg", "status"))
  res <- res[order(match(location, natural_order(location)),
                   match(responder, natural_order(responder)), date)]
  res <- round_cols(res)
  data.table::setattr(res, "pptm_table", "pigs")
  res[]
}

pig_summary <- function(pigs, end) {
  if (nrow(pigs) == 0L) {
    return(data.table::data.table(
      location = character(), responder = character(), days = integer(),
      no_visit_days = integer(), low_feed_days = integer(),
      mean_feed_kg = numeric(), last_feed_kg = numeric(), last_visits = integer(),
      last_weight_kg = numeric(), days_since_visit = integer(), status = character()))
  }
  res <- pigs[, {
    last <- date == end
    seen <- date[n_visits > 0L]
    wts <- weight_kg[!is.na(weight_kg)]
    .(days = .N,
      no_visit_days = sum(status == "no_visit"),
      low_feed_days = sum(status == "low_feed"),
      mean_feed_kg = mean(feed_kg),
      last_feed_kg = feed_kg[last][1L],
      last_visits = n_visits[last][1L],
      last_weight_kg = if (length(wts) > 0L) wts[length(wts)] else NA_real_,
      days_since_visit = if (length(seen) > 0L) as.integer(end - max(seen)) else NA_integer_,
      status = status[last][1L])
  }, by = .(location, responder)]
  round_cols(res)[]
}
```

```{r examples-monitor_pigs}
pigs <- monitor_pigs(tidypptsda::fire, days = 7, verbose = 0)
pigs[status != "ok"]
```

```{r tests-monitor_pigs}
test_that("pig table keeps days without visit", {
  v <- prep_visits(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
  end <- max(v$date)
  pig <- v[identified == TRUE, responder[1]]
  v2 <- v[!(responder %in% pig & date >= end - 1)]
  pg <- monitor_pigs(v2, days = 5, end_date = end, low_feed_kg = 0.5, verbose = 0)
  one <- pg[responder == pig]
  expect_equal(nrow(one), 5L)
  expect_equal(one[date >= end - 1, status], c("no_visit", "no_visit"))
  expect_equal(one[date >= end - 1, feed_kg], c(0, 0))
  # every pig has one row per day of the window
  expect_true(all(pg[, .N, by = responder]$N == 5L))
  expect_true(all(pg$status %in% c("ok", "low_feed", "no_visit")))
  expect_true(all(pg[status == "low_feed", feed_kg] < 0.5))
  ps <- pig_summary(pg, end)
  expect_equal(ps[responder == pig, days_since_visit], 2L)
  expect_equal(ps[responder == pig, no_visit_days], 2L)
  # a pig with high limit is low feed every day it visited
  pg_hi <- monitor_pigs(v, days = 2, low_feed_kg = 100, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(all(pg_hi[n_visits > 0, status] == "low_feed"))
})
```

## Hours of the day

```{r function-monitor_hours}
#' Hourly Table per Station for One Day
#'
#' @description
#' Visits, pigs, occupation time and feed intake per station and hour of
#' one day, for all 24 hours.
#'
#' @inheritParams run_monitor
#' @param date The day. Default `NULL`: the last full day in the data
#'   (see `end_date` in [run_monitor()]).
#'
#' @return A `data.table` with one row per station (`location`) and
#'   `hour` (0 to 23, from the entrance time): `date`, `n_pigs`,
#'   `n_visits`, `occupation_min` and `feed_kg`.
#' @seealso [run_monitor()].
#' @export
#' @examples
#' h <- monitor_hours(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
#' wide_table(h, "n_visits")
monitor_hours <- function(data, date = NULL, station = NULL, verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  v <- as_visits(data, station, verbose)
  hour_table(v, resolve_end_date(date, v))
}

hour_table <- function(v, day) {
  locs <- active_locations(v, day, day)
  w <- v[!is.na(location) & !is.na(date) & date == day]
  w[, hour := as.integer(format(entry_time, "%H", tz = "UTC"))]
  agg <- w[, .(n_pigs = data.table::uniqueN(responder[identified]),
               n_visits = .N,
               occupation_min = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
               feed_kg = sum(feed_intake, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000),
           by = .(location, hour)]
  grid <- data.table::CJ(location = locs, hour = 0:23)
  res <- agg[grid, on = c("location", "hour")]
  res[is.na(n_visits), `:=`(n_pigs = 0L, n_visits = 0L, occupation_min = 0, feed_kg = 0)]
  res[, date := day]
  data.table::setcolorder(res, c("location", "date", "hour"))
  res <- order_natural(res, "location")
  res <- round_cols(res)
  data.table::setattr(res, "pptm_table", "hours")
  res[]
}
```

```{r examples-monitor_hours}
h <- monitor_hours(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
wide_table(h, "n_visits")
```

```{r tests-monitor_hours}
test_that("hours cover the whole day", {
  v <- prep_visits(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
  end <- max(v$date)
  h <- monitor_hours(v, date = end, verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(nrow(h), 48L)
  expect_equal(sort(unique(h$hour)), 0:23)
  expect_equal(sum(h$n_visits), nrow(v[date == end]))
  expect_equal(unique(h$date), end)
})
```

## Alerts

```{r function-alerts}
#' Alerts of the last day
#' @filename alerts
#' @noRd
empty_alerts <- function() {
  data.table::data.table(level = character(), type = character(),
                         location = character(), responder = character(),
                         value = numeric(), message = character())
}

find_alerts <- function(stations, pig_sum, end, low_feed_kg,
                        max_unidentified_pct, max_feed_drop_pct) {
  last <- stations[date == end]
  down <- last[n_visits == 0L]
  pigs_at <- pig_sum[, .N, by = location]
  a_down <- if (nrow(down) > 0L) down[, .(level = "danger", type = "station_down", location,
                     responder = NA_character_, value = 0,
                     message = paste0("No visits on ", format(end),
                                      pigs_note(pigs_at$N[match(location, pigs_at$location)])))]
  un <- last[n_visits > 0L & pct_unidentified > max_unidentified_pct]
  a_un <- if (nrow(un) > 0L) un[, .(level = "warning", type = "unidentified", location,
                 responder = NA_character_, value = pct_unidentified,
                 message = sprintf("%.1f%% of the visits unidentified (%d of %d)",
                                   pct_unidentified, n_unidentified, n_visits))]
  prev <- stations[date < end & n_visits > 0L, .(mean_feed = mean(feed_kg)), by = location]
  fd <- last[prev, on = "location", nomatch = NULL
             ][n_visits > 0L & mean_feed > 0 & feed_kg < (1 - max_feed_drop_pct / 100) * mean_feed]
  a_fd <- if (nrow(fd) > 0L) fd[, .(level = "warning", type = "feed_drop", location,
                 responder = NA_character_, value = feed_kg,
                 message = sprintf("Feed intake %.1f kg, %.0f%% below the mean of the earlier days (%.1f kg)",
                                   feed_kg, 100 * (1 - feed_kg / mean_feed), mean_feed))]
  ps <- pig_sum[!location %in% down$location]
  nv <- ps[status == "no_visit"]
  lf <- ps[status == "low_feed"]
  a_nv <- if (nrow(nv) > 0L) nv[, .(level = "danger", type = "pig_no_visit", location,
             responder, value = as.numeric(days_since_visit),
             message = paste0("No visit for ", days_since_visit, " day",
                              ifelse(days_since_visit == 1L, "", "s"),
                              ifelse(is.na(last_weight_kg), "",
                                     sprintf(" (last weight %.1f kg)", last_weight_kg))))]
  a_lf <- if (nrow(lf) > 0L) lf[, .(level = "warning", type = "pig_low_feed", location,
             responder, value = last_feed_kg,
             message = sprintf("Ate %.2f kg (below %s kg); %d low-feed day%s in the window",
                               last_feed_kg, format(low_feed_kg), low_feed_days,
                               ifelse(low_feed_days == 1L, "", "s")))]
  parts <- list(a_down, a_un, a_fd, a_nv, a_lf)
  parts <- parts[vapply(parts, function(p) !is.null(p) && nrow(p) > 0L, logical(1))]
  out <- data.table::rbindlist(c(list(empty_alerts()), parts),
                               use.names = TRUE)
  if (nrow(out) == 0L) return(out)
  out[order(match(level, c("danger", "warning")),
            !is.na(responder),
            match(location, natural_order(location)),
            match(type, c("station_down", "unidentified", "feed_drop", "pig_no_visit", "pig_low_feed")),
            match(responder, natural_order(responder)))]
}

pigs_note <- function(n) {
  ifelse(is.na(n) | n == 0L, "", paste0(" (", n, " pig", ifelse(n == 1L, "", "s"), ")"))
}
```

```{r tests-alerts}
test_that("alert rules", {
  st <- data.table::data.table(
    location = rep(c("1", "2", "3"), each = 3),
    date = rep(as.Date("2024-01-01") + 0:2, 3),
    n_visits = c(100L, 100L, 0L, 100L, 100L, 100L, 100L, 100L, 100L),
    n_unidentified = c(0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 20L, 0L, 0L, 0L),
    pct_unidentified = c(0, 0, NA, 0, 0, 20, 0, 0, 0),
    feed_kg = c(30, 30, 0, 30, 30, 30, 30, 30, 10)
  )
  ps <- data.table::data.table(location = c("1", "3", "3"), responder = c("a", "b", "c"),
                               status = c("no_visit", "low_feed", "ok"),
                               days_since_visit = c(1L, 0L, 0L),
                               last_weight_kg = c(80, 70, 75), last_feed_kg = c(0, 0.2, 2),
                               low_feed_days = c(0L, 2L, 0L))
  a <- find_alerts(st, ps, as.Date("2024-01-03"), 0.5, 5, 30)
  expect_equal(a$type, c("station_down", "unidentified", "feed_drop", "pig_low_feed"))
  expect_equal(a$level, c("danger", "warning", "warning", "warning"))
  expect_match(a$message[1], "1 pig")
  expect_equal(nrow(find_alerts(st[date < "2024-01-03"], ps[0], as.Date("2024-01-02"), 0.5, 5, 30)), 0L)
})
```

# Wide tables

The daily tables are long: one row per unit and day. `wide_table()`
turns one column into a table with the units in rows and the days (or
hours) in columns, as in the Excel workbook.

```{r function-wide_table}
#' One Measure as a Wide Table
#'
#' @description
#' Turn one column of a daily table into a wide table: stations, houses
#' or pigs in rows, days (or hours) in columns, plus the total or mean
#' over the window.
#'
#' @param x A table from [monitor_stations()], [monitor_houses()],
#'   [monitor_pigs()] or [monitor_hours()] (also as part of
#'   [run_monitor()]).
#' @param value Name of the column to show, e.g. `"feed_kg"`.
#'
#' @return A `data.table`: the ID columns (`location`, `house`, or
#'   `location` and `responder`), one column per day (`"MM-DD"`, or
#'   `"YYYY-MM-DD"` when the window spans the same day of two years) or
#'   per hour, and `total` for counts, kg and time, `mean` otherwise.
#' @export
#' @examples
#' mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
#' wide_table(mon$stations, "n_visits")
#' wide_table(mon$pigs, "feed_kg")
#' wide_table(mon$hours, "feed_kg")
wide_table <- function(x, value) {
  kind <- attr(x, "pptm_table", exact = TRUE)
  if (!data.table::is.data.table(x) || is.null(kind)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg x} must be a table from {.fn monitor_stations}, {.fn monitor_houses}, {.fn monitor_pigs} or {.fn monitor_hours}.")
  }
  ids <- switch(kind, stations = "location", houses = "house",
                pigs = c("location", "responder"), hours = "location")
  col <- if (kind == "hours") "hour" else "date"
  if (!is.character(value) || length(value) != 1L || !value %in% setdiff(names(x), c(ids, col))) {
    num <- names(x)[vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))]
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg value} must be one of {.val {setdiff(num, col)}}.")
  }
  d <- x[, c(ids, col, value), with = FALSE]
  data.table::setnames(d, c(ids, ".col", ".value"))
  if (col == "date") {
    lab <- format(d$.col, "%m-%d")
    if (data.table::uniqueN(lab) < data.table::uniqueN(d$.col)) lab <- format(d$.col, "%Y-%m-%d")
    lv <- unique(lab[order(d$.col)])
  } else {
    lab <- sprintf("%02d", d$.col)
    lv <- sprintf("%02d", 0:23)
  }
  d[, .col := factor(lab, levels = lv)]
  f <- stats::as.formula(paste(paste(ids, collapse = " + "), "~ .col"))
  res <- data.table::dcast(d, f, value.var = ".value", drop = c(TRUE, FALSE))
  days <- setdiff(names(res), ids)
  additive <- value %in% c("n_visits", "n_unidentified", "occupation_h",
                           "occupation_min", "feed_kg")
  if (is.numeric(d$.value) && length(days) > 0L) {
    m <- as.matrix(res[, days, with = FALSE])
    if (additive) {
      res[, total := rowSums(m, na.rm = TRUE)]
    } else {
      res[, mean := nan_to_na(rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE))]
    }
  }
  res <- order_natural(res, ids)
  round_cols_like(res, value)[]
}

# Round the value columns of a wide table as the long column.
round_cols_like <- function(res, value) {
  d <- if (value %in% c("weight_kg", "last_weight_kg")) 2L
       else if (endsWith(value, "_kg")) 3L
       else if (startsWith(value, "pct_")) 1L
       else if (endsWith(value, "_h")) 2L
       else if (endsWith(value, "_min")) 1L
       else 3L
  for (col in names(res)) {
    if (is.double(res[[col]])) data.table::set(res, j = col, value = round(res[[col]], d))
  }
  res
}
```

```{r examples-wide_table}
mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
wide_table(mon$stations, "n_visits")
wide_table(mon$pigs, "feed_kg")
```

```{r tests-wide_table}
test_that("wide tables", {
  mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 4, verbose = 0)
  w <- wide_table(mon$stations, "feed_kg")
  expect_equal(names(w)[1], "location")
  expect_equal(ncol(w), 1L + 4L + 1L)
  expect_true("total" %in% names(w))
  expect_equal(sum(w$total), sum(mon$stations$feed_kg), tolerance = 1e-4)
  expect_true("mean" %in% names(wide_table(mon$stations, "weight_kg")))
  wp <- wide_table(mon$pigs, "feed_kg")
  expect_equal(names(wp)[1:2], c("location", "responder"))
  expect_equal(nrow(wp), data.table::uniqueN(mon$pigs$responder))
  wh <- wide_table(mon$hours, "n_visits")
  expect_equal(names(wh)[2:25], sprintf("%02d", 0:23))
  expect_error(wide_table(mon$stations, "nope"), "value")
  expect_error(wide_table(data.table::data.table(a = 1), "a"), "monitor_stations")
})
```

# Plots

`plot_monitor()` draws one plot per station. There are five types:

- `"trend"`: pigs, visits, unidentified visits, occupation time, feed
  intake and body weight over the window; days without any visit are
  shaded red;
- `"intake"`: stacked bars of the feed intake of each pig on each day: its
  share of the station's feed (top) and kg (bottom), as `fid_monitor()`
  of pptsdm drew them; pigs that did not visit or ate too little on the
  last day are marked in the legend;
- `"weight"`: recorded body weights per day as box plots;
- `"hours"`: visits, occupation time and feed intake per hour of the last
  day.

```{r function-plot_monitor}
#' Plot the Monitor, One Plot per Station
#'
#' @param x Result of [run_monitor()].
#' @param type `"trend"` (default), `"intake"`, `"weight"` or `"hours"`.
#'   See Details.
#' @param locations Stations to plot. Default `NULL`: all.
#'
#' @details
#' - `"trend"`: pigs, visits, percentage of unidentified visits, occupation
#'   time, feed intake, feed intake per pig and body weight on each day of
#'   the window. The body weight line is the mean over the pigs of their
#'   daily median weight; the band goes from the lightest to the heaviest
#'   pig. Days without any visit are shaded red.
#' - `"intake"`: stacked bars, one colour per pig. Top: the share of each
#'   pig in the feed intake of the station that day (%); bottom: its feed
#'   intake (kg), with the daily total above the bar (windows of up to 31
#'   days). In the legend, pigs without visit on the last day are marked
#'   `[no visit]` and pigs below `low_feed_kg` `[low feed]`.
#' - `"weight"`: box plots of the recorded body weights of each day.
#' - `"hours"`: visits, occupation time and feed intake per hour of the
#'   last day.
#'
#' @return A `data.table` with one row per station: `location`, `type`,
#'   `plot` (list of ggplot objects), and `width` and `height` (cm) that
#'   suit the plot when saving it with [save_monitor_plots()].
#' @seealso [save_monitor_plots()], [write_monitor_report()].
#' @export
#' @examples
#' mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
#' p <- plot_monitor(mon, "intake")
#' p$plot[[1]]
#' plot_monitor(mon, "trend", locations = "102")$plot[[1]]
plot_monitor <- function(x, type = c("trend", "intake", "weight", "hours"),
                         locations = NULL) {
  check_monitor(x)
  type <- match.arg(type)
  locs <- pick_locations(x, locations)
  one <- switch(type, trend = plot_trend_one, intake = plot_intake_one,
                weight = plot_weight_one, hours = plot_hours_one)
  res <- lapply(locs, function(l) one(x, l))
  data.table::data.table(
    location = locs, type = type,
    plot = lapply(res, `[[`, "plot"),
    width = vapply(res, `[[`, numeric(1), "width"),
    height = vapply(res, `[[`, numeric(1), "height")
  )
}

pick_locations <- function(x, locations) {
  all_locs <- natural_order(x$stations$location)
  if (is.null(locations)) return(all_locs)
  locations <- as.character(locations)
  bad <- setdiff(locations, all_locs)
  if (length(bad) > 0L) {
    cli::cli_abort(c("Unknown station{?s}: {.val {bad}}.", "i" = "Stations: {.val {all_locs}}."))
  }
  all_locs[all_locs %in% locations]
}

pptm_theme <- function() {
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#667085"),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )
}

# One tick per day (or every few days for long windows), only inside the
# window.
date_scale <- function(s) {
  step <- max(1L, ceiling(s$days / 14))
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(breaks = rev(seq(s$end_date, s$start_date, by = -step)),
                        date_labels = "%m-%d",
                        limits = c(s$start_date - 0.5, s$end_date + 0.5),
                        expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.1))
}

plot_width <- function(days) max(16, 0.7 * days + 8)

empty_plot <- function(title, msg) {
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = msg, colour = "#667085") +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title) +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))
}

trend_labels <- c(n_pigs = "Pigs", n_visits = "Visits",
                  pct_unidentified = "Unidentified (%)",
                  occupation_h = "Occupation (h)", feed_kg = "Feed (kg)",
                  feed_per_pig_kg = "Feed per pig (kg)",
                  weight_kg = "Weight (kg)")

plot_trend_one <- function(x, l) {
  s <- x$settings
  d <- x$stations[location == l]
  num <- d[, c("date", names(trend_labels)), with = FALSE]
  num[, (names(trend_labels)) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = names(trend_labels)]
  long <- data.table::melt(num, id.vars = "date", measure.vars = names(trend_labels),
                           variable.name = "metric", value.name = "value",
                           variable.factor = FALSE)
  long[, metric := factor(trend_labels[metric], levels = trend_labels)]
  down <- d[n_visits == 0L, .(date)]
  # weight band: lightest to heaviest pig of the day (daily medians)
  band <- x$pigs[location == l & !is.na(weight_kg),
                 .(lo = min(weight_kg), hi = max(weight_kg)), by = date]
  band[, metric := factor(trend_labels[["weight_kg"]], levels = trend_labels)]
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(long, ggplot2::aes(date, value))
  if (nrow(down) > 0L) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_rect(data = down, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                                ggplot2::aes(xmin = date - 0.5, xmax = date + 0.5),
                                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#B42318", alpha = 0.15)
  }
  if (nrow(band) > 0L) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_ribbon(data = band, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                                  ggplot2::aes(x = date, ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                                  fill = "#999999", alpha = 0.25)
  }
  p <- p +
    ggplot2::geom_line(ggplot2::aes(colour = metric), na.rm = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(colour = metric), size = 1.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(metric ~ ., scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(pptm_palette(length(trend_labels) - 1L), "#1B2A4A"),
                                 guide = "none") +
    date_scale(s) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = paste("Station", l),
                  subtitle = paste0(format(s$start_date), " to ", format(s$end_date),
                                    "; weight band: lightest to heaviest pig",
                                    if (nrow(down) > 0L) "; red: no visits")) +
    pptm_theme() +
    ggplot2::theme(strip.placement = "outside",
                   strip.text.y.left = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
                   strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank())
  list(plot = p, width = plot_width(s$days), height = 3.2 * length(trend_labels) + 3)
}

# Distinct colours for many pigs: ColorBrewer Paired and Dark2 (as in
# pptsdm), then interpolated.
pig_palette <- function(n) {
  pal <- c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C", "#FB9A99", "#E31A1C",
           "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6", "#6A3D9A", "#B15928", "#8DD3C7",
           "#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A", "#66A61E", "#E6AB02",
           "#A6761D", "#666666")
  if (n > length(pal)) pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(pal)(n)
  pal[seq_len(n)]
}

plot_intake_one <- function(x, l) {
  s <- x$settings
  title <- paste("Station", l, "- feed intake per pig")
  d <- x$pigs[location == l & n_visits > 0L]
  if (nrow(d) == 0L) {
    return(list(plot = empty_plot(title, "No identified pig in the window"),
                width = 16, height = 6))
  }
  lv <- natural_order(d$responder)
  ps <- x$pig_summary[location == l]
  flag <- ps$status[match(lv, ps$responder)]
  labels <- paste0(lv, ifelse(flag %in% "no_visit", " [no visit]",
                              ifelse(flag %in% "low_feed", " [low feed]", "")))
  d[, pig := factor(responder, levels = lv)]
  d[, total := sum(feed_kg), by = date]
  d[, share := data.table::fifelse(total > 0, 100 * feed_kg / total, 0)]
  panels <- c("Share of station feed (%)", "Feed intake (kg)")
  long <- rbind(d[, .(date, pig, value = share, panel = panels[1])],
                d[, .(date, pig, value = feed_kg, panel = panels[2])])
  long[, panel := factor(panel, levels = panels)]
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(long, ggplot2::aes(date, value, fill = pig)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.8, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1,
                      position = ggplot2::position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pig_palette(length(lv)), labels = labels,
                               name = "Pig", drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08)))
  if (s$days <= 31L) {
    tot <- unique(d[, .(date, total)])
    tot[, panel := factor(panels[2], levels = panels)]
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_text(data = tot, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                                ggplot2::aes(date, total, label = formatC(total, format = "f", digits = 1)),
                                vjust = -0.4, size = 2.6, colour = "#1D2330")
  }
  n_flag <- sum(flag %in% c("no_visit", "low_feed"))
  ncol <- max(1L, ceiling(length(lv) / 25))
  p <- p + date_scale(s) +
    ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(ncol = ncol)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title,
                  subtitle = paste0(length(lv), " pigs; bottom: daily total above the bar",
                                    if (n_flag > 0L) paste0("; ", n_flag, " pig",
                                      if (n_flag > 1L) "s", " marked in the legend on ",
                                      format(s$end_date)))) +
    pptm_theme() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right",
                   legend.key.size = ggplot2::unit(0.4, "cm"),
                   legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
                   strip.placement = "outside",
                   strip.text.y.left = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90),
                   strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank())
  # legend width from the longest label, so that long tag numbers
  # (e.g. 15-digit electronic ear tags) do not squeeze the bars
  leg_w <- 0.2 * max(nchar(labels)) + 1.4
  list(plot = p, width = plot_width(s$days) + leg_w * ncol + 1,
       height = max(18, 0.45 * length(lv) / ncol + 6))
}

plot_weight_one <- function(x, l) {
  s <- x$settings
  d <- x$visits[location == l & identified == TRUE & !is.na(weight)]
  title <- paste("Station", l, "- recorded body weights")
  if (nrow(d) == 0L) {
    return(list(plot = empty_plot(title, "No body weight in the window"), width = 16, height = 6))
  }
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(date, weight, group = date)) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(fill = "#E6F0FA", colour = "#0F6CBD", outlier.colour = "#B42318",
                          outlier.size = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    date_scale(s) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(r) pretty(r, n = 8)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Body weight (kg)", title = title,
                  subtitle = "All weights of the identified visits; red: outside the whiskers") +
    pptm_theme()
  list(plot = p, width = plot_width(s$days), height = 10)
}

hour_labels <- c(n_visits = "Visits", occupation_min = "Occupation (min)",
                 feed_kg = "Feed (kg)")

plot_hours_one <- function(x, l) {
  s <- x$settings
  d <- x$hours[location == l, c("hour", names(hour_labels)), with = FALSE]
  d[, (names(hour_labels)) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = names(hour_labels)]
  long <- data.table::melt(d, id.vars = "hour", measure.vars = names(hour_labels),
                           variable.name = "metric", value.name = "value",
                           variable.factor = FALSE)
  long[, metric := factor(hour_labels[metric], levels = hour_labels)]
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(long, ggplot2::aes(hour, value, fill = metric)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(metric ~ ., scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pptm_palette(3), guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23, expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.5)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Hour of the day", y = NULL,
                  title = paste("Station", l, "- hours of", format(s$end_date))) +
    pptm_theme() +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
                   strip.placement = "outside",
                   strip.text.y.left = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
                   strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank())
  list(plot = p, width = 18, height = 12)
}
```

```{r examples-plot_monitor}
mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
plot_monitor(mon, "intake")$plot[[1]]
```

```{r tests-plot_monitor}
test_that("plots for every type", {
  mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 5, verbose = 0)
  for (tp in c("trend", "intake", "weight", "hours")) {
    p <- plot_monitor(mon, tp)
    expect_equal(p$location, c("101", "102"))
    expect_true(all(vapply(p$plot, ggplot2::is.ggplot, logical(1))))
    expect_true(all(p$width > 0 & p$height > 0))
    # only ASCII text, so that every graphics device can draw the plots
    labs <- unlist(lapply(p$plot, function(g) c(g$labels$title, g$labels$subtitle)))
    expect_false(any(grepl("[^ -~]", labs)))
  }
  # a pig without visit on the last day is marked in the intake legend
  v <- prep_visits(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
  end <- max(v$date)
  pig <- v[location == "101" & identified, responder[1]]
  mon2 <- run_monitor(v[!(responder %in% pig & date == end)], days = 5, verbose = 0)
  g <- plot_monitor(mon2, "intake", locations = "101")$plot[[1]]
  b <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(g)
  expect_true(any(grepl("\\[no visit\\]", b$plot$scales$get_scales("fill")$get_labels())))
  expect_true("Weight (kg)" %in% levels(plot_monitor(mon2, "trend", "101")$plot[[1]]$data$metric))
  # long tag numbers widen the intake plot instead of squeezing the bars
  v_long <- data.table::copy(v)
  v_long[!is.na(responder), responder := sprintf("9980260421%05d", as.integer(responder))]
  mon_long <- run_monitor(v_long, days = 5, verbose = 0)
  expect_gt(plot_monitor(mon_long, "intake", "101")$width,
            plot_monitor(run_monitor(v, days = 5, verbose = 0), "intake", "101")$width)
  expect_error(plot_monitor(mon, "heatmap"), "should be one of")
  expect_error(plot_monitor(mon, "trend", locations = "999"), "Unknown station")
  expect_error(plot_monitor(list()), "run_monitor")
})
```

## Saving plots

```{r function-save_monitor_plots}
#' Save Monitor Plots to Files
#'
#' @param plots Result of [plot_monitor()], or several of them bound with
#'   `rbind()`.
#' @param path Folder to write to (created if needed).
#' @param device `"png"` (default) or `"pdf"`.
#' @param dpi Resolution for PNG files. Default 150.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent) or 1 (summary, default).
#'
#' @return Invisibly, a `data.table` with `location`, `type`, `file` and
#'   `saved` (`FALSE` when the plot could not be saved; a warning names
#'   the reason). Files are named `station_<location>_<type>.<device>`.
#' @export
#' @examples
#' mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
#' p <- rbind(plot_monitor(mon, "trend"), plot_monitor(mon, "intake"))
#' dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_plots")
#' save_monitor_plots(p, dir)
#' unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
save_monitor_plots <- function(plots, path, device = c("png", "pdf"), dpi = 150,
                               verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  device <- match.arg(device)
  path <- check_path(path)
  if (!data.table::is.data.table(plots) ||
      !all(c("location", "type", "plot", "width", "height") %in% names(plots))) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg plots} must be the result of {.fn plot_monitor}.")
  }
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  files <- file.path(path, paste0("station_", plots$location, "_", plots$type, ".", device))
  ok <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(plots)), function(i) {
    err <- tryCatch({
      ggplot2::ggsave(files[i], plots$plot[[i]], width = plots$width[i],
                      height = plots$height[i], units = "cm", dpi = dpi,
                      device = device, limitsize = FALSE)
      NA_character_
    }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
    if (!is.na(err)) {
      f <- files[i]
      pptm_msg("Could not save {.file {f}}: {err}", "warning")
    }
    is.na(err)
  }, logical(1))
  res <- data.table::data.table(location = plots$location, type = plots$type,
                                file = files, saved = ok)
  pptm_msg("Saved {sum(ok)} of {length(ok)} plot{?s} to {.path {path}}",
           if (all(ok)) "success" else "warning")
  invisible(res)
}
```

```{r examples-save_monitor_plots}
mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_plots")
save_monitor_plots(plot_monitor(mon, "trend"), dir)
unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r tests-save_monitor_plots}
test_that("plots are saved", {
  mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 3, verbose = 0)
  dir <- withr::local_tempdir()
  res <- save_monitor_plots(rbind(plot_monitor(mon, "trend"), plot_monitor(mon, "hours")),
                            dir, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(all(res$saved))
  expect_true(all(file.exists(res$file)))
  expect_equal(basename(res$file[1]), "station_101_trend.png")
  expect_error(save_monitor_plots(list(), dir), "plot_monitor")
})
```

# HTML report

`write_monitor_report()` writes the monitor as a small offline website,
as `write_report()` does in tidypptsda: an overview page with the alerts
and a table of all stations, then one page per station with its plots and
its pigs. Turn the pages with the arrow keys and type a pig ID to jump to
its station.

```{r function-write_monitor_report}
#' Write an HTML Report to Browse Station by Station
#'
#' @description
#' Write the monitor as a folder with `index.html` and the plots (`img/`).
#' Open `index.html` in a web browser:
#' - the first page is an overview of the last day: stations, pigs,
#'   visits, feed intake, the alerts, a table of all stations and one of
#'   all houses, and the settings;
#' - then one page per station: its alerts, the plots `"trend"`,
#'   `"intake"`, `"weight"` and `"hours"` of [plot_monitor()] and a table of
#'   its pigs.
#'
#' Turn the pages with the arrow keys (or Page Up / Page Down, Home, End),
#' the buttons or the list of stations; type a pig ID in the search box to
#' jump to its station. Printing the page (e.g. to PDF) prints every page.
#' The folder works offline and can be copied or zipped as a whole.
#'
#' @param x Result of [run_monitor()].
#' @param path Folder to write to (created if needed). Files of an earlier
#'   report in the folder are overwritten.
#' @param title Title of the report. Default: station type and window.
#' @param locations Stations to include. Default `NULL`: all.
#' @param dpi Resolution of the plots. Default 150.
#' @param open Open the report in the web browser when done. Default
#'   `FALSE`.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent) or 1 (summary, default).
#'
#' @return Invisibly, the path of `index.html`.
#' @seealso [write_monitor_tables()] for the Excel workbook.
#' @export
#' @examples
#' mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
#' dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_report")
#' write_monitor_report(mon, dir)
#' # then open file.path(dir, "index.html") in a web browser
#' unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
write_monitor_report <- function(x, path, title = NULL, locations = NULL,
                                 dpi = 150, open = FALSE, verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  check_monitor(x)
  path <- check_path(path)
  locs <- pick_locations(x, locations)
  img <- file.path(path, "img")
  dir.create(img, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  types <- c("trend", "intake", "weight", "hours")
  plots <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(types, function(tp) plot_monitor(x, tp, locs)))
  sv <- save_monitor_plots(plots, img, dpi = dpi, verbose = 0)
  bad <- sv[saved == FALSE]
  if (nrow(bad) > 0L) {
    pptm_msg("{nrow(bad)} plot{?s} could not be saved.", "warning")
  }
  files <- sv[saved == TRUE, .(location, type, file = basename(file))]

  title <- title %||% monitor_title(x)
  html <- monitor_html(x, locs, files, title)
  out <- file.path(path, "index.html")
  writeLines(enc2utf8(html), out, useBytes = TRUE)
  pptm_msg("Report of {length(locs)} station{?s} written to {.path {out}}", "success")
  if (isTRUE(open)) utils::browseURL(normalizePath(out))
  invisible(out)
}

monitor_title <- function(x) {
  s <- x$settings
  paste0(trimws(paste(toupper(s$station), "station monitor")), ", ",
         format(s$start_date), " to ", format(s$end_date))
}

html_esc <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub("\"", "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}

# Number for a table cell: "" for NA.
html_num <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  out <- formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
  out[is.na(x)] <- ""
  out
}

status_label <- c(ok = "ok", low_feed = "low feed", no_visit = "no visit",
                  danger = "danger", warning = "warning")

html_tag <- function(s) {
  paste0("<span class=\"tag s-", s, "\">", html_esc(status_label[s]), "</span>")
}

html_table <- function(head, rows) {
  paste0("<div class=\"scroll\"><table class=\"pigs\"><thead><tr>", head,
         "</tr></thead><tbody>", paste(rows, collapse = "\n"), "</tbody></table></div>")
}

html_alerts <- function(a, page_of, link = TRUE) {
  if (nrow(a) == 0L) return("<p class=\"muted\">None.</p>")
  st <- if (link) {
    paste0("<a href=\"#p-", page_of[a$location], "\" data-page=\"", page_of[a$location], "\">",
           html_esc(a$location), "</a>")
  } else html_esc(a$location)
  pig <- ifelse(is.na(a$responder), "",
                if (link) paste0("<a href=\"#p-", page_of[a$location], "\" data-page=\"",
                                 page_of[a$location], "\" data-pig=\"", html_esc(a$responder), "\">",
                                 html_esc(a$responder), "</a>")
                else html_esc(a$responder))
  rows <- paste0("<tr><td>", html_tag(a$level), "</td><td class=\"id\">", st,
                 "</td><td class=\"id\">", pig, "</td><td>", html_esc(gsub("_", " ", a$type)),
                 "</td><td class=\"note\">", html_esc(a$message), "</td></tr>")
  html_table("<th>Level</th><th>Station</th><th>Pig</th><th>Alert</th><th>Detail</th>", rows)
}

html_station_rows <- function(last, page_of, n_alerts) {
  na <- n_alerts[last$location]
  na[is.na(na)] <- 0L
  paste0("<tr", ifelse(last$n_visits == 0L, " class=\"s-down\"", ""), "><td class=\"id\">",
         "<a href=\"#p-", page_of[last$location], "\" data-page=\"", page_of[last$location], "\">",
         html_esc(last$location), "</a></td>",
         "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(last$n_pigs), "</td>",
         "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(last$n_visits), "</td>",
         "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(last$pct_unidentified, 1), "</td>",
         "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(last$occupation_h, 1), "</td>",
         "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(last$feed_kg, 1), "</td>",
         "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(last$feed_per_pig_kg, 2), "</td>",
         "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(last$weight_kg, 1), "</td>",
         "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(last$pct_weight_outlier, 1), "</td>",
         "<td class=\"n", ifelse(na > 0L, " warn", ""), "\">", na, "</td></tr>")
}

station_head <- paste0(
  "<th>Station</th><th class=\"n\">Pigs</th><th class=\"n\">Visits</th>",
  "<th class=\"n\">Unidentified<br><small>%</small></th>",
  "<th class=\"n\">Occupation<br><small>h</small></th>",
  "<th class=\"n\">Feed<br><small>kg</small></th>",
  "<th class=\"n\">Feed per pig<br><small>kg</small></th>",
  "<th class=\"n\">Weight<br><small>kg</small></th>",
  "<th class=\"n\">Weight outliers<br><small>%</small></th>",
  "<th class=\"n\">Alerts</th>")

html_pig_table <- function(d) {
  if (nrow(d) == 0L) return("<p class=\"muted\">No identified pig in the window.</p>")
  id <- html_esc(d$responder)
  rows <- paste0(
    "<tr id=\"pig-", id, "\"><td class=\"id\">", id, "</td>",
    "<td>", html_tag(d$status), "</td>",
    "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(d$last_visits), "</td>",
    "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(d$last_feed_kg, 2), "</td>",
    "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(d$mean_feed_kg, 2), "</td>",
    "<td class=\"n", ifelse(d$low_feed_days > 0L, " warn", ""), "\">", d$low_feed_days, "</td>",
    "<td class=\"n", ifelse(d$no_visit_days > 0L, " warn", ""), "\">", d$no_visit_days, "</td>",
    "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(d$days_since_visit), "</td>",
    "<td class=\"n\">", html_num(d$last_weight_kg, 1), "</td></tr>")
  html_table(paste0(
    "<th>Pig</th><th>Status</th><th class=\"n\">Visits</th>",
    "<th class=\"n\">Feed<br><small>kg</small></th>",
    "<th class=\"n\">Mean feed<br><small>kg/d</small></th>",
    "<th class=\"n\">Low-feed<br><small>days</small></th>",
    "<th class=\"n\">No-visit<br><small>days</small></th>",
    "<th class=\"n\">Days since<br><small>visit</small></th>",
    "<th class=\"n\">Weight<br><small>kg</small></th>"), rows)
}

monitor_html <- function(x, locs, files, title) {
  s <- x$settings
  page_of <- stats::setNames(seq_along(locs), locs)
  last <- x$stations[date == s$end_date & location %in% locs]
  last <- last[match(locs, location)]
  a <- x$alerts[location %in% locs]
  n_alerts <- table(factor(a$location, levels = locs))
  n_alerts <- stats::setNames(as.integer(n_alerts), names(n_alerts))
  ps <- x$pig_summary[location %in% locs]
  ps_rec <- ps[location %in% last[n_visits > 0L, location]]

  card <- function(label, value, sub = "") {
    paste0("<div class=\"card\"><div class=\"label\">", label, "</div><div class=\"value\">",
           value, "</div><div class=\"sub\">", sub, "</div></div>")
  }
  n_down <- sum(last$n_visits == 0L)
  vis <- sum(last$n_visits)
  unid <- sum(last$n_unidentified)
  feed <- sum(last$feed_kg)
  cards <- paste0(
    "<div class=\"cards\">",
    card("Stations", length(locs),
         if (n_down > 0L) paste0("<span class=\"warn\">", n_down, " without visits</span>")
         else "all recording"),
    card("Pigs", nrow(ps), paste0(sum(ps_rec$status == "no_visit"), " no visit &middot; ",
                                  sum(ps_rec$status == "low_feed"), " low feed",
                                  if (n_down > 0L) " (recording stations)")),
    card("Visits", html_num(vis), paste0(html_num(if (vis > 0) 100 * unid / vis else NA, 1),
                                         "% unidentified")),
    card("Feed intake", paste0(html_num(feed, 1), " kg"),
         paste0(html_num(if (sum(last$n_pigs) > 0L)
                           sum(last$feed_per_pig_kg * last$n_pigs, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(last$n_pigs)
                         else NA, 2), " kg per pig")),
    card("Alerts", nrow(a), paste0(sum(a$level == "danger"), " danger &middot; ",
                                   sum(a$level == "warning"), " warning")),
    "</div>")

  set_val <- function(v) html_esc(paste(as.character(v), collapse = ", "))
  settings <- c(
    "Window" = paste0(format(s$start_date), " to ", format(s$end_date), " (", s$days, " days)"),
    "Low feed" = paste0("below ", set_val(s$low_feed_kg), " kg per day"),
    "Unidentified visits" = paste0("alert above ", set_val(s$max_unidentified_pct), "%"),
    "Feed drop" = paste0("alert more than ", set_val(s$max_feed_drop_pct), "% below the mean of the earlier days"),
    "Weight outliers" = paste0("Tukey fences, k = ", set_val(s$iqr_k)),
    "House" = paste0("first ", s$house_width, " character", if (s$house_width > 1L) "s", " of the station ID"),
    "Package" = paste0("tidypptsdm ", utils::packageVersion("tidypptsdm"),
                       ", tidypptsda ", utils::packageVersion("tidypptsda"))
  )
  settings_html <- paste0("<dl class=\"settings\">",
                          paste0("<dt>", names(settings), "</dt><dd>", settings, "</dd>", collapse = ""),
                          "</dl>")
  hl <- x$houses[date == s$end_date]
  house_html <- html_table(
    paste0("<th>House</th><th class=\"n\">Stations</th><th class=\"n\">Pigs</th>",
           "<th class=\"n\">Visits</th><th class=\"n\">Feed<br><small>kg</small></th>",
           "<th class=\"n\">Feed per pig<br><small>kg</small></th>",
           "<th class=\"n\">Weight<br><small>kg</small></th>"),
    paste0("<tr><td class=\"id\">", html_esc(hl$house), "</td><td class=\"n\">", hl$n_stations,
           "</td><td class=\"n\">", hl$n_pigs, "</td><td class=\"n\">", html_num(hl$n_visits),
           "</td><td class=\"n\">", html_num(hl$feed_kg, 1), "</td><td class=\"n\">",
           html_num(hl$feed_per_pig_kg, 2), "</td><td class=\"n\">", html_num(hl$weight_kg, 1),
           "</td></tr>"))
  overview <- paste0(
    "<section class=\"page\" id=\"p-0\" data-title=\"Overview\">",
    "<h1>Overview</h1><p class=\"lead\">Last day: ", format(s$end_date), "</p>", cards,
    "<h2>Alerts", if (nrow(a) > 0L) paste0(" <span class=\"count\">", nrow(a), "</span>"), "</h2>",
    html_alerts(a, page_of),
    "<h2>Stations on ", format(s$end_date), "</h2>",
    html_table(station_head, html_station_rows(last, page_of, n_alerts)),
    "<h2>Houses on ", format(s$end_date), "</h2>", house_html,
    "<h2>Settings</h2>", settings_html, "</section>")

  fig <- function(l, tp, cap) {
    f <- files[location == l & type == tp, file]
    if (length(f) == 0L) return("")
    src <- paste0("img/", utils::URLencode(f[1L], reserved = TRUE))
    paste0("<figure><a href=\"", src, "\" target=\"_blank\" title=\"Open the full-size plot\">",
           "<img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"", src, "\" alt=\"", html_esc(cap), "\"></a>",
           "<figcaption>", cap, "</figcaption></figure>")
  }
  station_pages <- vapply(locs, function(l) {
    b <- last[location == l]
    al <- a[location == l]
    sub <- paste0(b$n_pigs, " pig", if (b$n_pigs != 1L) "s", " &middot; ",
                  html_num(b$n_visits), " visits &middot; ", html_num(b$feed_kg, 1),
                  " kg feed on ", format(s$end_date),
                  if (b$n_visits == 0L) " &middot; <span class=\"warn\">no visits</span>")
    paste0("<section class=\"page\" id=\"p-", page_of[[l]], "\" data-title=\"Station ",
           html_esc(l), "\" hidden><h1>Station ", html_esc(l), "</h1><p class=\"lead\">", sub, "</p>",
           if (nrow(al) > 0L) paste0("<h2>Alerts <span class=\"count\">", nrow(al), "</span></h2>",
                                     html_alerts(al, page_of, link = FALSE)),
           fig(l, "trend", "Daily trend over the window, with the body weight of the pigs (band: lightest to heaviest); red: days without visits"),
           fig(l, "intake", "Feed intake per pig and day: share of the station (top) and kg (bottom); pigs without visit or with low feed on the last day are marked in the legend"),
           "<h2>Pigs</h2>", html_pig_table(ps[location == l]),
           fig(l, "weight", "Recorded body weights per day"),
           fig(l, "hours", paste("Visits, occupation and feed intake per hour of", format(s$end_date))),
           "</section>")
  }, "")

  nav <- paste0("<a href=\"#p-0\" data-page=\"0\" class=\"nav-item\">Overview</a>",
                paste0("<a href=\"#p-", page_of, "\" data-page=\"", page_of,
                       "\" class=\"nav-item\">Station ", html_esc(locs),
                       ifelse(n_alerts[locs] > 0L,
                              paste0(" <span class=\"badge\" title=\"alerts\">", n_alerts[locs], "</span>"),
                              ""),
                       "</a>", collapse = ""))
  pig_map <- if (nrow(ps) > 0L) {
    paste0("{", paste0("\"", gsub("([\"\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", ps$responder), "\":",
                       page_of[ps$location], collapse = ","), "}")
  } else "{}"

  tpl <- report_template()
  repl <- c("{{TITLE}}" = html_esc(title), "{{NAV}}" = nav,
            "{{PAGES}}" = paste(c(overview, station_pages), collapse = "\n"),
            "{{PIGS}}" = pig_map, "{{DATE}}" = format(Sys.Date()))
  for (k in names(repl)) tpl <- gsub(k, repl[[k]], tpl, fixed = TRUE)
  tpl
}

report_template <- function() {
  r"---(<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>{{TITLE}}</title>
<style>
:root { --bg:#f6f7f9; --panel:#fff; --ink:#1d2330; --muted:#667085; --line:#e3e6eb;
  --accent:#0f6cbd; --accent-soft:#e6f0fa; --ok:#1a7f4b; --ok-soft:#e5f4ec; --warn:#a15c00;
  --warn-soft:#fdf1df; --bad:#b42318; --bad-soft:#fdecea; --hit:#fff3b0; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { --bg:#14171c; --panel:#1c2027; --ink:#e7eaf0;
  --muted:#98a2b3; --line:#2e343d; --accent:#6cb4f5; --accent-soft:#1d3247; --ok:#5fcf93;
  --ok-soft:#183427; --warn:#f2b45c; --warn-soft:#3a2c17; --bad:#f5877d; --bad-soft:#3d1f1d;
  --hit:#4a4214; } figure img { background:#fff; } }
* { box-sizing:border-box; }
html, body { margin:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--ink);
  font:15px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; }
a { color:var(--accent); text-decoration:none; } a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
header { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:5; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;
  padding:10px 16px; background:var(--panel); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
header .title { font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; flex:1; min-width:0; }
header .title small { color:var(--muted); font-weight:400; margin-left:8px; }
.pager { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
button { font:inherit; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink);
  border-radius:6px; padding:5px 11px; cursor:pointer; }
button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent); }
```
