```{r function-write_monitor_report}
button:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:default; }
#counter { min-width:64px; text-align:center; color:var(--muted); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
#search { font:inherit; width:150px; padding:5px 9px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--bg); color:var(--ink); }
#search.miss { border-color:var(--bad); }
#menu { display:none; }
.layout { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; }
nav { position:sticky; top:53px; width:200px; flex:none; max-height:calc(100vh - 53px); overflow:auto;
  padding:10px 8px; border-right:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel); min-height:calc(100vh - 53px); }
.nav-item { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:5px 10px;
  border-radius:6px; color:var(--ink); }
.nav-item:hover { background:var(--bg); text-decoration:none; }
.nav-item.active { background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); font-weight:600; }
.badge { background:var(--warn-soft); color:var(--warn); border-radius:10px; padding:0 7px;
  font-size:12px; font-weight:600; }
main { flex:1; min-width:0; padding:20px 28px 60px; max-width:1200px; }
h1 { font-size:24px; margin:0 0 4px; } h2 { font-size:17px; margin:28px 0 10px; }
.lead, .muted { color:var(--muted); margin-top:0; } .warn { color:var(--warn); font-weight:600; }
.count { background:var(--warn-soft); color:var(--warn); border-radius:10px; padding:0 8px; font-size:13px; }
.cards { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap:12px; margin:16px 0; }
.card { background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 14px; }
.card .label { color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; } .card .value { font-size:24px; font-weight:600;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .card .sub { color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; }
.settings { display:grid; grid-template-columns:max-content 1fr; gap:4px 18px; margin:0;
  background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 14px; }
.settings dt { color:var(--muted); } .settings dd { margin:0; }
figure { margin:16px 0; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:10px; }
figure img { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:4px; }
figcaption { color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; margin-top:6px; }
.scroll { overflow-x:auto; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; }
table.pigs { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:14px; }
.pigs th, .pigs td { padding:6px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); text-align:left; vertical-align:top; }
.pigs th { color:var(--muted); font-weight:500; font-size:13px; background:var(--panel); white-space:nowrap; }
.pigs tr:last-child td { border-bottom:0; }
.pigs .n { text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap; }
.pigs .id { font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; } .pigs .note { color:var(--muted); min-width:200px; }
tr.s-down td { background:var(--bad-soft); }
tr.hit td { background:var(--hit); transition:background .3s; }
.tag { display:inline-block; border-radius:10px; padding:0 8px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; }
.tag.s-ok { background:var(--ok-soft); color:var(--ok); }
.tag.s-low_feed, .tag.s-warning { background:var(--warn-soft); color:var(--warn); }
.tag.s-no_visit, .tag.s-danger { background:var(--bad-soft); color:var(--bad); }
.keys { color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; margin-top:40px; }
kbd { border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px; padding:0 5px; font-size:11px; background:var(--panel); }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  #menu { display:inline-block; } header { flex-wrap:wrap; } header .title { flex-basis:calc(100% - 60px); }
  #search { width:110px; } nav { display:none; position:fixed; top:auto; left:0; z-index:4; height:100vh;
    box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2); } nav.open { display:block; } main { padding:16px; }
}
@media print {
  header, nav, .keys { display:none !important; } .page { display:block !important; page-break-after:always; }
  main { padding:0; max-width:none; } body { background:#fff; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <button id="menu" aria-label="Stations">&#9776;</button>
  <div class="title">{{TITLE}}<small id="pagetitle"></small></div>
  <input id="search" type="search" placeholder="Pig ID" aria-label="Find a pig" autocomplete="off">
  <div class="pager">
    <button id="prev" title="Previous (&larr;)">&larr;</button>
    <span id="counter"></span>
    <button id="next" title="Next (&rarr;)">&rarr;</button>
  </div>
</header>
<div class="layout">
<nav id="nav">{{NAV}}</nav>
<main>
{{PAGES}}
<p class="keys"><kbd>&larr;</kbd> <kbd>&rarr;</kbd> turn pages &middot; <kbd>Home</kbd> overview &middot;
<kbd>End</kbd> last station &middot; <kbd>/</kbd> find a pig &middot; written {{DATE}} with tidypptsdm</p>
</main>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var PIGS = {{PIGS}};
  var pages = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".page"));
  var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".nav-item"));
  var n = pages.length, cur = -1;
  var prev = document.getElementById("prev"), next = document.getElementById("next");
  var counter = document.getElementById("counter"), ptitle = document.getElementById("pagetitle");
  var search = document.getElementById("search"), nav = document.getElementById("nav");
  function show(i, pig) {
    i = Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, i));
    if (i !== cur) {
      pages.forEach(function (p, k) { p.hidden = k !== i; });
      links.forEach(function (a, k) { a.classList.toggle("active", k === i); });
      cur = i;
      counter.textContent = i === 0 ? "Overview" : i + " / " + (n - 1);
      ptitle.textContent = i === 0 ? "" : pages[i].getAttribute("data-title");
      prev.disabled = i === 0; next.disabled = i === n - 1;
      if (links[i] && links[i].scrollIntoView) links[i].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    }
    var hash = pig ? "#pig-" + encodeURIComponent(pig) : "#p-" + i;
    if (location.hash !== hash) history.replaceState(null, "", hash);
    if (pig) {
      var row = document.getElementById("pig-" + pig);
      if (row) {
        row.classList.add("hit");
        row.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
        setTimeout(function () { row.classList.remove("hit"); }, 2500);
      }
    }
    nav.classList.remove("open");
  }
  function fromHash() {
    var h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash || "");
    var m = /^#p-(\d+)$/.exec(h);
    if (m) return show(+m[1]);
    m = /^#pig-(.+)$/.exec(h);
    if (m && PIGS.hasOwnProperty(m[1])) return show(PIGS[m[1]], m[1]);
    show(0);
  }
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var a = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest("[data-page]") : null;
    if (!a) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    show(+a.getAttribute("data-page"), a.getAttribute("data-pig"));
  });
  prev.onclick = function () { show(cur - 1); };
  next.onclick = function () { show(cur + 1); };
  document.getElementById("menu").onclick = function () { nav.classList.toggle("open"); };
  search.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape") { search.value = ""; search.blur(); return; }
    if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
    var v = search.value.trim();
    if (PIGS.hasOwnProperty(v)) { search.classList.remove("miss"); show(PIGS[v], v); }
    else search.classList.add("miss");
  });
  search.addEventListener("input", function () { search.classList.remove("miss"); });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.target === search || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "PageDown") { show(cur + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "PageUp") { show(cur - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (e.key === "Home") { show(0); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (e.key === "End") { show(n - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (e.key === "/") { search.focus(); e.preventDefault(); }
  });
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", fromHash);
  fromHash();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
)---"
}
```

```{r examples-write_monitor_report}
mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_report")
write_monitor_report(mon, dir)
unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r tests-write_monitor_report}
test_that("the report has an overview and one page per station", {
  mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, days = 5, verbose = 0)
  dir <- withr::local_tempdir()
  f <- write_monitor_report(mon, dir, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(file.exists(f))
  html <- paste(readLines(f, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")
  expect_match(html, "id=\"p-0\"")
  expect_match(html, "Station 101")
  expect_match(html, "Station 102")
  expect_false(grepl("{{", html, fixed = TRUE))
  expect_equal(length(list.files(file.path(dir, "img"))), 2L * 4L)
  f2 <- write_monitor_report(mon, withr::local_tempdir(), locations = "102", verbose = 0)
  expect_false(grepl("Station 101", paste(readLines(f2), collapse = "")))
  expect_error(write_monitor_report(mon, ""), "path")
})
```

# Excel workbook and CSV files

```{r function-write_monitor_tables}
#' Write the Monitor Tables to Excel or CSV
#'
#' @description
#' Write the tables of [run_monitor()] as one Excel workbook, with a colour
#' scale on every wide sheet, or as CSV files.
#'
#' @param x Result of [run_monitor()].
#' @param path Folder to write to (created if needed).
#' @param format `"xlsx"` (default; needs the openxlsx package) or
#'   `"csv"`.
#' @param file File name without extension (xlsx) or prefix of the file
#'   names (csv). Default `"monitor"`.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent) or 1 (summary, default).
#'
#' @section Sheets:
#' The workbook has the long tables `Alerts`, `Stations`, `Houses`, `Pigs`
#' (the `pig_summary` of [run_monitor()]) and `Pig days`, and wide sheets
#' (see [wide_table()]) with a colour scale from red (a possible problem)
#' over yellow to green:
#'
#' | Sheet | Values | Red for |
#' |---|---|---|
#' | `Visits` | visits per station and day | low |
#' | `Unidentified pct` | unidentified visits, % | high |
#' | `Feed kg` | feed intake per station | low |
#' | `Feed per pig kg` | feed intake per pig | low |
#' | `Occupation h` | occupation time | low |
#' | `Weight outliers pct` | body weight outliers, % | high |
#' | `House feed per pig kg` | feed intake per pig and house | low |
#' | `House weight kg` | mean body weight per house | (blue scale) |
#' | `Pig feed kg` | feed intake per pig and day | low |
#' | `Hours visits`, `Hours feed kg` | per hour of the last day | (blue scale) |
#'
#' The CSV files are the long tables `<file>_alerts.csv`,
#' `<file>_stations.csv`, `<file>_houses.csv`, `<file>_pigs.csv`,
#' `<file>_pig_days.csv` and `<file>_hours.csv`, written with a byte order
#' mark so that Excel opens them in UTF-8.
#'
#' @return Invisibly, the path(s) of the written file(s).
#' @export
#' @examples
#' mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
#' dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_tables")
#' write_monitor_tables(mon, dir, format = "csv")
#' if (requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) {
#'   write_monitor_tables(mon, dir)
#' }
#' unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
write_monitor_tables <- function(x, path, format = c("xlsx", "csv"),
                                 file = "monitor", verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  check_monitor(x)
  path <- check_path(path)
  format <- match.arg(format)
  if (!is.character(file) || length(file) != 1L || !nzchar(file)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg file} must be a file name.")
  }
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  long <- list(alerts = x$alerts, stations = x$stations, houses = x$houses,
               pigs = x$pig_summary, pig_days = x$pigs, hours = x$hours)
  if (format == "csv") {
    out <- file.path(path, paste0(file, "_", names(long), ".csv"))
    for (i in seq_along(long)) data.table::fwrite(long[[i]], out[i], bom = TRUE)
    pptm_msg("Wrote {length(out)} CSV file{?s} to {.path {path}}", "success")
    return(invisible(out))
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) {
    cli::cli_abort(c("Writing Excel files needs the {.pkg openxlsx} package.",
                     "i" = "Install it with {.code install.packages(\"openxlsx\")}, or use {.code format = \"csv\"}."))
  }
  st <- x$stations
  sheets <- list(
    list("Alerts", x$alerts, NULL, 0L),
    list("Stations", st, NULL, 1L),
    list("Visits", wide_table(st, "n_visits"), "low", 1L),
    list("Unidentified pct", wide_table(st, "pct_unidentified"), "high", 1L),
    list("Feed kg", wide_table(st, "feed_kg"), "low", 1L),
    list("Feed per pig kg", wide_table(st, "feed_per_pig_kg"), "low", 1L),
    list("Occupation h", wide_table(st, "occupation_h"), "low", 1L),
    list("Weight outliers pct", wide_table(st, "pct_weight_outlier"), "high", 1L),
    list("Houses", x$houses, NULL, 1L),
    list("House feed per pig kg", wide_table(x$houses, "feed_per_pig_kg"), "low", 1L),
    list("House weight kg", wide_table(x$houses, "weight_kg"), "blue", 1L),
    list("Pigs", x$pig_summary, NULL, 2L),
    list("Pig feed kg", wide_table(x$pigs, "feed_kg"), "low", 2L),
    list("Pig days", x$pigs, NULL, 2L),
    list("Hours visits", wide_table(x$hours, "n_visits"), "blue", 1L),
    list("Hours feed kg", wide_table(x$hours, "feed_kg"), "blue", 1L)
  )
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  head_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center",
                                      fgFill = "#F2F2F2", border = "bottom")
  colours <- list(low = c("#F8696B", "#FFEB84", "#63BE7B"),
                  high = c("#63BE7B", "#FFEB84", "#F8696B"),
                  blue = c("#FFFFFF", "#9DC3E6", "#2E75B6"))
  for (sh in sheets) {
    name <- sh[[1L]]
    d <- sh[[2L]]
    n_id <- sh[[4L]]
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, name)
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, name, d, headerStyle = head_style)
    openxlsx::freezePane(wb, name, firstActiveRow = 2L, firstActiveCol = n_id + 1L)
    openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, name, cols = seq_len(max(1L, ncol(d))), widths = "auto")
    if (!is.null(sh[[3L]]) && nrow(d) > 0L && ncol(d) > n_id) {
      openxlsx::conditionalFormatting(wb, name, cols = (n_id + 1L):ncol(d),
                                      rows = 2:(nrow(d) + 1L), type = "colorScale",
                                      style = colours[[sh[[3L]]]])
    }
  }
  out <- file.path(path, paste0(file, ".xlsx"))
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, out, overwrite = TRUE)
  pptm_msg("Wrote {.file {out}} ({length(sheets)} sheets)", "success")
  invisible(out)
}
```

```{r examples-write_monitor_tables}
mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_tables")
write_monitor_tables(mon, dir, format = "csv")
unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r tests-write_monitor_tables}
test_that("tables are written as CSV and Excel", {
  mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::fire, days = 5, verbose = 0)
  dir <- withr::local_tempdir()
  csv <- write_monitor_tables(mon, dir, format = "csv", verbose = 0)
  expect_equal(length(csv), 6L)
  expect_true(all(file.exists(csv)))
  back <- data.table::fread(csv[2])
  expect_equal(nrow(back), nrow(mon$stations))
  skip_if_not_installed("openxlsx")
  xl <- write_monitor_tables(mon, dir, verbose = 0)
  expect_true(file.exists(xl))
  sh <- openxlsx::getSheetNames(xl)
  expect_equal(length(sh), 16L)
  expect_true(all(c("Alerts", "Feed kg", "Pig feed kg", "Hours visits") %in% sh))
  expect_equal(nrow(openxlsx::read.xlsx(xl, "Feed kg")), data.table::uniqueN(mon$stations$location))
  expect_error(write_monitor_tables(mon, dir, file = ""), "file")
})
```

# Run every day

`schedule_monitor()` writes an R script that reads the export folder,
runs the monitor and writes the report and the workbook into a folder
named after the last day. On Windows the script is registered in the
Task Scheduler (with the taskscheduleR package). On Linux and macOS the
function prints the line to add with `crontab -e`.

```{r function-schedule_monitor}
#' Run the Monitor Every Day
#'
#' @description
#' Write an R script that runs the whole monitor on a folder of station
#' exports, and schedule it to run every day:
#' - on Windows it is registered in the Task Scheduler with the
#'   taskscheduleR package;
#' - on Linux and macOS the line to add to the crontab (`crontab -e`) is
#'   printed.
#'
#' Every run reads all exports in `folder` ([read_station()]), runs
#' [run_monitor()], and writes [write_monitor_report()] and
#' [write_monitor_tables()] into `out_dir/<last day>/`.
#'
#' @param folder Folder with the station exports.
#' @param out_dir Folder for the results; one subfolder per day.
#' @param time Time of the daily run, `"HH:MM"`. Default `"07:30"`.
#' @param taskname Name of the scheduled task and of the script. Letters,
#'   digits, `_` and `-` only. Default `"tidypptsdm_monitor"`.
#' @param script_dir Folder for the script. Default `out_dir`.
#' @param format Format of the tables, see [write_monitor_tables()].
#'   Default `"xlsx"`.
#' @param register Register the task (Windows) or print the crontab line.
#'   Default `TRUE`. With `FALSE` only the script is written, e.g. to run
#'   it by hand with `Rscript`.
#' @param ... Arguments of [run_monitor()] such as `days`,
#'   `house_width`, `low_feed_kg` or `station`.
#' @param verbose 0 (silent) or 1 (summary, default).
#'
#' @return Invisibly, the path of the script.
#' @export
#' @examples
#' folder <- file.path(tempdir(), "exports")
#' dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
#' data.table::fwrite(tidypptsda::nedap, file.path(folder, "nedap.csv"))
#' out <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_runs")
#' script <- schedule_monitor(folder, out, days = 7, register = FALSE)
#' cat(readLines(script), sep = "\n")
#' # run once by hand
#' source(script)
#' list.files(out, recursive = TRUE)
#' unlink(c(folder, out), recursive = TRUE)
schedule_monitor <- function(folder, out_dir, time = "07:30",
                             taskname = "tidypptsdm_monitor", script_dir = out_dir,
                             format = c("xlsx", "csv"), register = TRUE, ...,
                             verbose = 1) {
  local_verbose(verbose)
  format <- match.arg(format)
  for (arg in c("folder", "out_dir", "script_dir")) {
    val <- get(arg)
    if (!is.character(val) || length(val) != 1L || !nzchar(val)) {
      cli::cli_abort("{.arg {arg}} must be a folder name.")
    }
  }
  if (!dir.exists(folder)) cli::cli_abort("Folder not found: {.path {folder}}.")
  if (!is.character(time) || length(time) != 1L ||
      !grepl("^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$", time)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg time} must be a time such as {.val 07:30}.")
  }
  if (!is.character(taskname) || length(taskname) != 1L ||
      !grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", taskname)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg taskname} may contain only letters, digits, {.val _} and {.val -}.")
  }
  args <- list(...)
  ok_args <- setdiff(names(formals(run_monitor)), c("data", "verbose"))
  bad <- setdiff(names(args), ok_args)
  if (length(args) > 0L && (is.null(names(args)) || any(!nzchar(names(args))) || length(bad) > 0L)) {
    cli::cli_abort(c("{.arg ...} must be named arguments of {.fn run_monitor}.",
                     "i" = "Allowed: {.arg {ok_args}}."))
  }

  norm <- function(p) normalizePath(p, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  dir.create(script_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  script <- file.path(norm(script_dir), paste0(taskname, ".R"))
  call_args <- vapply(names(args), function(nm) {
    paste0(nm, " = ", paste(deparse(args[[nm]]), collapse = " "))
  }, "")
  run_call <- paste0("mon <- tidypptsdm::run_monitor(",
                     paste(c(deparse(norm(folder)), call_args), collapse = ", "), ")")
  lines <- c(
    paste0("# Written by tidypptsdm::schedule_monitor() on ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")),
    "# Daily monitor of the testing stations: edit the settings below if needed.",
    run_call,
    paste0("out <- file.path(", deparse(norm(out_dir)), ", format(mon$settings$end_date))"),
    "tidypptsdm::write_monitor_report(mon, out)",
    paste0("tidypptsdm::write_monitor_tables(mon, out, format = ", deparse(format), ")")
  )
  writeLines(lines, script, useBytes = TRUE)
  pptm_msg("Monitor script written to {.file {script}}", "success")

  if (isTRUE(register)) {
    if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
      if (!requireNamespace("taskscheduleR", quietly = TRUE)) {
        cli::cli_abort(c("Scheduling on Windows needs the {.pkg taskscheduleR} package.",
                         "i" = "Install it with {.code install.packages(\"taskscheduleR\")}, or schedule {.file {script}} yourself."))
      }
      taskscheduleR::taskscheduler_create(taskname = taskname, rscript = script,
                                          schedule = "DAILY", starttime = time)
      pptm_msg("Task {.val {taskname}} runs every day at {time}. Remove it with {.code taskscheduleR::taskscheduler_delete(\"{taskname}\")}.", "success")
    } else {
      hm <- as.integer(strsplit(time, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]])
      rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript")
      line <- sprintf("%d %d * * * \"%s\" \"%s\" >> \"%s\" 2>&1", hm[2L], hm[1L], rscript, script,
                      sub("\\.R$", ".log", script))
      pptm_msg("Add this line with {.code crontab -e} to run the monitor every day at {time}:", "info")
      if (pptm_verbose() >= 1L) cli::cli_verbatim(line)
    }
  }
  invisible(script)
}
```

```{r examples-schedule_monitor}
folder <- file.path(tempdir(), "exports")
dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
data.table::fwrite(tidypptsda::nedap, file.path(folder, "nedap.csv"))
out <- file.path(tempdir(), "monitor_runs")
script <- schedule_monitor(folder, out, days = 7, register = FALSE)
cat(readLines(script), sep = "\n")
unlink(c(folder, out), recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r tests-schedule_monitor}
test_that("the scheduled script runs the whole monitor", {
  folder <- withr::local_tempdir()
  out <- withr::local_tempdir()
  data.table::fwrite(tidypptsda::fire, file.path(folder, "fire.csv"))
  script <- schedule_monitor(folder, out, days = 5, low_feed_kg = 1, format = "csv",
                             register = FALSE, verbose = 0)
  txt <- readLines(script)
  expect_match(paste(txt, collapse = "\n"), "days = 5")
  expect_match(paste(txt, collapse = "\n"), "low_feed_kg = 1")
  withr::with_options(list(tidypptsdm.verbose = 0L), {
    e <- new.env()
    suppressMessages(sys.source(script, envir = e))
  })
  res <- list.files(out, recursive = TRUE)
  expect_true(any(grepl("index.html$", res)))
  expect_true(any(grepl("monitor_alerts.csv$", res)))
  expect_error(schedule_monitor(folder, out, nope = 1, register = FALSE), "run_monitor")
  expect_error(schedule_monitor(folder, out, time = "25:00", register = FALSE), "time")
  expect_error(schedule_monitor(file.path(folder, "missing"), out, register = FALSE), "not found")
  if (.Platform$OS.type != "windows") {
    expect_message(schedule_monitor(folder, out, register = TRUE), "crontab")
  }
})
```
